title: The Chamba Miracle and Banda’s Reception

blocks.text: This page closes the Chamba crossing with a miracle story: Banda drives his horse through a dangerous torrent, turns it back again, and leaves behind a stone horse in the stream that becomes the wonder of the place. The terrible display of miracle shakes the Chamba vazir so deeply that he falls at Banda’s feet and begs pardon for his earlier resistance.
After that submission the page turns toward settlement rather than confrontation. Banda entered Chamba in triumph, met the Chamba ruler directly, and was received with honor inside the hill state.
The closing lines therefore work as a hinge between marvel and alliance. They move from the stone horse in the stream to the beginning of Banda’s accepted residence in Chamba.
